question: Where is asset TAG-1001 located?
gold_cypher: MATCH (a:Asset {asset_tag: 'TAG-1001'})-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location) RETURN l.name AS LocationName;

question: Who supplied asset TAG-1001?
gold_cypher: MATCH (a:Asset {asset_tag: 'TAG-1001'})-[:PURCHASED_FROM]->(v:Vendor) RETURN v.name AS VendorName;

question: Which sites contain assets supplied by TechSupply Inc?
gold_cypher: MATCH (v:Vendor)-[:PURCHASED_FROM]-(a:Asset)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Site) WHERE toLower(v.name) CONTAINS toLower('TechSupply') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS SiteName, count(a) AS AssetCount;

question: Which vendors supply items stored in more than one site?
gold_cypher: MATCH (v:Vendor)-[:SUPPLIES]->(i:Item)<-[:INSTANCE_OF]-(a:Asset)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Site) WITH v, count(DISTINCT s) AS site_count WHERE site_count > 1 RETURN v.name AS Vendor, site_count;

question: Show the path from TechSupply Inc to the assets located at Headquarters.
gold_cypher: MATCH p = (v:Vendor)-[:PURCHASED_FROM]-(a:Asset)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Site {name: 'Headquarters'}) WHERE toLower(v.name) CONTAINS toLower('TechSupply') RETURN p LIMIT 5;

question: Which customers bought items supplied by TechSupply Inc?
gold_cypher: MATCH (v:Vendor)-[:SUPPLIES]->(i:Item)<-[:CONTAINS]-(so:SalesOrder)<-[:PLACED]-(c:Customer) WHERE toLower(v.name) CONTAINS toLower('TechSupply') RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS CustomerName, i.name AS ItemName;

question: Which vendor is connected to the largest number of sites?
gold_cypher: MATCH (v:Vendor)-[:PURCHASED_FROM]-(a:Asset)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Site) RETURN v.name AS Vendor, count(DISTINCT s) AS SiteCount ORDER BY SiteCount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which sites depend on the supplier Global Office Needs?
gold_cypher: MATCH (v:Vendor)-[:PURCHASED_FROM]-(a:Asset)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(s:Site) WHERE toLower(v.name) CONTAINS toLower('Global Office') RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS DependentSite;
